details.description: Grok 4.20 is a chat model from xAI, released in March 2026 (the 0309 dated snapshot) as part of the Grok 4.20 family alongside a Grok 4.20 Multi-agent model. This is the non-reasoning variant, which answers directly without an extended reasoning step. It accepts text and image input and produces text output, with a 1,000,000-token context window, and supports function calling, structured outputs and the Batch API.
advantages: Accepts both text and image input for text output, per xAI's model documentation.
Supports native function calling and structured outputs, per xAI's documentation.
Answers without an extended reasoning step, per xAI's documentation, unlike the grok-4.20-0309-reasoning variant of the same model.
disadvantages: Does not use extended reasoning before answering, per xAI's documentation, unlike the grok-4.20-0309-reasoning variant of the same model.
xAI's documentation states that logprobs and top_logprobs are not supported by grok-4.20 and newer models.
use_cases: Lower-latency chat responses where extended reasoning is not needed
Agentic workflows that call tools/functions as part of multi-step tasks
Vision tasks that combine image and text input

notes: xAI's own pages describe the model with marketing language ('industry-leading speed', 'lowest hallucination rate on the market') that is not tied to a published benchmark number, so it is left out per the no-unattributed-superlatives rule; no evaluation scores were found on any page opened. Facts (1M context, image+text input to text output, xai provider) match the catalog. Model status is not labeled beta/preview/deprecated on the current models or release-notes pages.
